title: Let a registered Papyrus site create an account entitled to its own product
description:
Feature: Account creation from a registered Papyrus site
  Scenario: A signed-in, enrolled person creates a newsroom account
    Given a person enrolled through a registered papyrus-<site> registration
    When the site server calls POST /v1/accounts as the site role with the person's access token and an Idempotency-Key UUID
    Then the API policy admits the call, central makes the person owner and entitles only that site's product
    And accountCreationLimits apply (409 account_limit beyond the limit)

  Scenario: Public-reader sites cannot create accounts
    Given a registration with audience public-reader
    When it calls POST /v1/accounts
    Then it is refused

Gap on 2026-10-31: accounts/papyrus-sites.ts papyrusSiteRoutes has no POST/v1/accounts, so Papyrus's create route (Papyrus PRs 330/331, recorded on kanbus-5161d7) is refused by the API resource policy. Change: add exactly POST/v1/accounts (never /v1/accounts/*) for editor sites only, keep the access-policy size test (infra/test/accounts-plane.test.ts) passing, and update docs/accounts/PAPYRUS_SITES.md "What a site may call". This is an API resource-policy change, so it needs Ryan's approval of the synthesized policy.
